title: Is Capy Kingdom Worth Playing? An Honest Look From the Dev
subtitle: What it is, what it asks of you and who it is for.
description: Is Capy Kingdom worth playing? An honest developer look at this free idle shooter for Android: ads, purchases, offline play, languages and who will enjoy it.
card: Is Capy Kingdom worth playing? The honest developer answer: what it is, how it makes money, how much time it asks, and who should skip it.

faq.q: Is Capy Kingdom free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Capy Kingdom is free, with optional rewarded ads you choose to watch for a bonus, and optional purchases such as gem packs, a starter bundle and permanent boosts. Nothing is required to progress, and no ads pop up in your way.

faq.q: Does Capy Kingdom need an account?
faq.a: No. There is no account and no sign-up. Your progress is saved on your device. The game also includes a Support panel in Settings where you can contact the developer.

faq.q: What languages does Capy Kingdom support?
faq.a: Twelve: English, Dutch, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Italian and Turkish.
